host_availability_window_check.name: host_availability_window_check
host_availability_window_check.value: "host_availability"."weekday" is not null or ("host_availability"."date_from" is not null and "host_availability"."date_to" is not null)

host_availability_date_range_check.name: host_availability_date_range_check
host_availability_date_range_check.value: "host_availability"."date_from" is null or "host_availability"."date_to" is null or "host_availability"."date_to" >= "host_availability"."date_from"

round_participants_membership_check.name: round_participants_membership_check
round_participants_membership_check.value:
("round_participants"."is_member" and "round_participants"."user_id" is not null and "round_participants"."guest_name" is null)
        or (not "round_participants"."is_member" and "round_participants"."user_id" is null and "round_participants"."guest_name" is not null)
